subject: Telemetry vendor RFQs, evaluation & rollover plan
messages:
From: Carlos Vega <carlos@amplitude.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Amplitude RFQ submission + quick summary

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, attaching the preliminary quote and a high-level sizing worksheet for your API telemetry volumes. Key notes:

- Quoted for 24-month term with 10% annual increase in event volume allowance.
- We recommend the "Pro Plus" plan for full previews, raw export access, and dedicated ingestion SLA.
- We can provide a pilot discount for the first quarter to offset migration costs.

I attached: amplitude_quote_Q3_2027.pdf and a CSV with your July–September ingestion estimates.

Next steps I propose: shared scoring matrix from your side, then we build a PoC plan (2–3 weeks) to validate ingestion paths and long-term cost.

If useful, I can join a 30-min sync with product + infra this week.

Best,
Carlos Vega
Enterprise Sales, Amplitude
carlos@amplitude.com
+1 415 555 0182

--- Attachment: usage_export_jul-sep.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos@amplitude.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Amplitude RFQ submission + quick summary

Carlos —

Thanks for the materials. We pulled together an initial RFQ scoring sheet (attached) that prioritizes: total cost of ownership, raw export latency, integration effort for API-level telemetry, and long-term vendor lock risk. A few clarifying Qs before we run scoring:

1) Can you confirm if the "dedicated ingestion SLA" includes backfill speed guarantees? Our SE teams have concerns about replays during rollout windows.
2) Is there a commitment on endpoint throughput for SDK vs server-side ingestion? We have spikes > 5K reqs/s at peak.
3) Do you offer an on-prem connector for high-compliance accounts (we want to keep that option for Private deployments)?

We also plan to run a parallel RFQ with Segment and Mixpanel — not because we want three vendors, but to compare the real integration effort and downstream query costs. I copied Laura (product analytics lead) and Marcus (infra) to weigh in on migration risk.

Can you hold time Friday 9/17 11:00–11:30 PT for a joint session?

Thanks,
Mina
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

--- Attachment: rfq_aggregated_scoring_sheet.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

From: Priya Nair <priya@segment.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Segment RFQ materials + connector options

Hi Mina —

Thanks for including us. I've attached a short note outlining Segment's ingestion options for API-level telemetry (Server-side vs HTTP Proxy), plus a pricing sketch for 12/24 month tiers. Highlights:

- Proxy mode reduces SDK churn but adds operational overhead — we can offer a managed proxy for the first 90 days.
- We can provide a migration credit for customers moving from raw-event exports to Warehouse Syncs.
- On-prem connector is available via our enterprise bundle (requires additional licensing).

We'll plan to join the 9/17 sync. I'm copying Marissa (customer success) so we have product-side context.

Best,
Priya Nair
Account Executive, Segment
priya@segment.io

--- Attachment: segment_connector_note.pdf (PDF, 16KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry RFQs — infra considerations and PoC ask

Team —

Quick take from infra:

- We should prioritize the path that preserves our raw KV cache exports. Rebuilding downstream indices for Mixpanel-like product analytics is non-trivial.
- Peak ingestion and burst handling matter more to SLOs than steady-state per-event cost. Ask vendors for official throughput SLA and backpressure behavior.
- PoC checklist (minimal): ingestion path, replay/backfill, raw export latency, query cost for a 90-day lookback, and permissioned access for Private deployments.

Marcus
Senior Infra Eng, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: RFQ scoring, PoC slots, and timeline (for 9/17 sync)

Folks —

Thanks to everyone who sent materials. Summary/asks ahead of Friday's 9/17 sync (11:00–11:30 PT):

1) Vendors: please come prepared to confirm SLA language for throughput and backfill, and to show a one-slide PoC plan that maps to our PoC checklist.
2) Redwood: we'll share the aggregated scoring sheet live and have Product run a short demo of our current instrumented events.
3) Timeline: target vendor selection by 10/01, PoC week 10/11–10/15, and production rollover window in November (low-traffic weekend).

If the vendors are able to provide a redline-able Master Services Agreement draft before selection, that will speed procurement. I've attached the current scoring sheet and the usage export again for reference.

Thanks,
Mina
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
